description:
The Rambler is built for riders who start with comfort and quickly discover they want more ride. Smooth, stable, and easy to enjoy, it takes the approachable TerraTrike experience and adds a more refined feel for longer rides, more varied routes, and a little extra “let’s keep going.”

With 24” wheels, an upright seating position, and a lightweight chro-moly steel frame, the Rambler delivers a smooth ride that still feels responsive through corners. The breathable mesh seat, full seat adjustability, disc brakes, and wide range of accessory compatibility make it a comfortable, capable platform you can shape around the way you ride.

Equipped with a 2x drivetrain, the Rambler adds more gear range without losing the easy-going feel riders already love. You still get the familiar low gears for relaxed climbing, but now you also have more top-end range when the path opens up and your legs say, “Why not?”

Whether you’re riding for fitness, freedom, fresh air, or just a better way to spend the afternoon, the Rambler is ready to grow with you.

Key Features

24” wheels for smooth rolling and an easy, confident ride.
Upright seating position for comfort, visibility, and control.
Lightweight chro-moly steel frame for a smooth, responsive feel.
2x drivetrain for wider gear range, easier climbing, and more top-end speed.
Breathable mesh seat with full adjustability for personalized comfort.
Disc brakes for reliable stopping power.
Compatible with a wide range of TerraTrike accessories.

The Rambler is comfortable enough to start easy and capable enough to keep going.

Because sometimes the best ride is the one that turns into something more.

*Please note - This TerraTrike comes equipped with our Comfort Pedal Conversion Kit!
